description: Lignes de transport en projet en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant les tracés des projets de transport en commun en Île-de-France. Un projet de ligne de transport est l'amélioration, le prolongement d'une ligne existante, ainsi que la création d'une nouvelle ligne de transport. En savoir plus sur les lignes en projet: Qualité Une ligne décrit le tracé du projet. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Transports en commun, Métro, Tramway, Bus, Géolocalisation, IDG. The portal shows 50 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
